description: Queue a transactional email and return its id. The call returns as soon as the message is ACCEPTED, not when it is delivered: use vaemail_get_message to find out what happened to it. Pass idempotency_key when retrying so a network timeout cannot send the same message twice.

html.description: HTML body. Required unless template_id is given.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-side unique id for this send. Replays the first response instead of sending again.

tag.description: Free label, useful to find the message later.

template_id.description: Transactional template to render instead of html.

name: vaemail_send_email
title: Send an email
